name: Ama Ie
source:
Masaki was informed by his employer that he was to be transferred to the city of Rokujou, far away from Tokyo. As he was preparing for the move, he received a request from his parents to live with his aunt and her family while checking up on how her marriage is doing. He was reluctant to interfere with other people’s business, but finally relented under his parent’s deep worry for his aunt’s marriage.

He was welcomed to the city by his aunt Kyouko and her daughters Mizuho and Kotomi. He had met them once a long time ago, but he was astounded by how beautiful they’ve become, how voluptuous their bodies had grown. Will he be able to keep his wits living under the same roof with them? Moreover, his new supervisor at work is an American blonde beauty with a figure that rivals theirs. Did he wander into a kingdom of big tits and asses?
translation:
正树接到雇主通知，将被调往远离东京的六条市。准备搬家时，父母请求他与姨母及家人同住，顺便确认姨母的婚姻状况。他不愿插手别人的家事，可面对父母对姨母婚姻的深切担忧，最终还是答应了。

他在六条市受到姨母京子及其女儿瑞穗和琴美的欢迎。很久以前他曾见过她们一次，却被她们如今的美貌与更加丰满的身材震惊。和她们生活在同一屋檐下，他能保持冷静吗？更何况，他工作中的新上司还是一名身材足以与她们媲美的美国金发美女。

他是不是误入了巨乳翘臀王国？
